items.rationale: 5>3 is TRUE and NOT flips it to FALSE.
<> means not equal to, so D2<>"Core" is TRUE exactly when D2="Core" is FALSE. Comparing with "Not Core" tests for different text, > is an ordering test, and a minus sign on text causes an error.

Line 1 passes: not Core, 13 is at least 12, not marked down. Line 2 is Core, so it fails. Line 3 is already marked down, so it fails. Line 4 passes: not Core, sell-through 29% is below 30%, not marked down. So 2 lines go on clearance.

AND needs the line to pass every test. NOT(E2="Yes") is FALSE when E2 is Yes, so AND fails and the line stays out. E2="Yes" does the opposite, OR(E2,"Yes") is not a valid test, and NOT(E2="No") would be FALSE for lines that have not been marked down.
